cfo_brief: Revenue rose from $30.04B in Q2 2024 to $32.54B in Q3 2024, a $2.5B (+8.32%) sequential increase, per SEC 10-Q filings. This jump exceeds normal enterprise/gaming growth patterns and coincides with a same-day CNBC report (Nov 22, 2024) citing "unprecedented demand" for Nvidia's Blackwell chips, suggesting management attributed the beat directly to next-gen Data Center GPU ramp rather than legacy Hopper/H100 sales. The exact-date alignment between the earnings filing and the Blackwell demand narrative indicates this was a disclosed, structural driver in the Q3 MD&A/earnings call—not incidental press coverage.

external_signal.headline: Nvidia Blackwell chips see unprecedented demand.
